status: prospective execution specification before fitting; exploratory reused lessons
secondary_comparison: all_blocks versus content_only quiz binomial Brier and log loss
outer: two held topic families crossed with four participant groups, with no participant or lesson shared
inner: hold one remaining lecture and one remaining participant group; fit everything within inner training scope
stacking: behavior training EEG predictions are participant-group cross-fitted inside each training scope; not lesson-cross-fitted
EEG_encoder: multi-output ridge, weighted mean squared standardized error plus lambda=1 times squared coefficients, unpenalized intercept, positive softplus variance shift
EEG_source: existing authenticated 44-second summary targets at five-second queries; no full-data deployed EEG weights reused
EEG_architecture_scope: supervised transfer readout of the system's frozen multimodal representations; not the v3 production TCN artifact
features: existing frozen native audio, visual, language, TRIBE and SAM/content descriptors; 16 dimensions per block; no outcome annotations or quiz text/answers supplied to feature extraction
dimension_control: append 16 content-joint PCs and 8 of those PCs instead of 16 TRIBE PCs and 8 predicted EEG coordinates; equal added width, not independent information or identical regularization

attention.head: ridge clipped to 1..5
attention.query: exact response video position after a uniquely matched cue
attention.cue_match: last contiguous flash_on run, response on run or within 0.5 seconds after it and <=0.5 media seconds from its last position; exactly one response per cue
attention.continuity: trailing playback begins after previous cue/manual pause, no backward seek or >1 second poll gap

quiz.head: regularized binomial logistic
quiz.unit: assessment, one probability for five items
quiz.covariate: observed pre-quiz fraction supplied to all arms
quiz.features: mean of fully supported 44-second content windows at five-second query intervals, no label-dependent pooling
quiz.eligibility: verified five-item pre/post pair, answer key and totals reconciled, logged viewing reaches >=99% of media duration

weighting: equal supported lecture, then equal viewing, then equal probes or assessment trials
negative_control: within-viewing cyclic EEG target reassignment, seed1729, training scopes only
offline_context_departure: Cached pretrained features can use context beyond a query, and semantic bins can straddle it. This is offline whole-lesson prediction; strict causal future isolation is not satisfied and no online/causal forecasting claim is permitted. All arms share the same source scope.
missingness: common feature-supported observations across arms per endpoint; missing EEG does not remove held behavior; unsupported training/selection cells reported without replacement

uncertainty.method: paired lecture/participant cluster resampling conditional on fixed fits; descriptive only
